briefings.headline: Valverde wins it at 90+2 in Athens; Madrid and PSG both perfect in the UCL

sections.title: 🏆 Champions League
items: **AEK Athens 2–3 Real Madrid** (Wed, Athens). Madrid trailed twice and won it in stoppage time.
Madrid had 70% of the ball and 3.35 xG to AEK's 0.86, so it shouldn't have been this stressful. Koita was sent off after the final whistle for arguing with the referee.
**Mbappé** has now scored in 6 straight UCL games.
**Table after MD4:** **PSG** 1st (12 pts, +15), **Real Madrid** 2nd (12 pts, +6). PSG's 6–0 at Villarreal on Tuesday (4 goals in 17 minutes, a UCL record) gives them the goal-difference edge.
**Next:** Real Madrid vs. PSV on Tue 11/24, PSG vs. Roma on Wed 11/25. Both 3:00 PM ET on Paramount+.

sections.title: 🏛️ Real Madrid & PSG
items: **Real Madrid** are without **Rodrygo** (knee, aiming for early 2027), **Mendy** (thigh) and **Asencio** (stress fracture, about 3 months out).
**Vinícius** serves the last game of his domestic ban on Saturday and should be back vs. Celta on 11/21.
**PSG vs. Troyes** moved from 20:45 to 21:05 Paris time, a knock-on from a schedule change in another Ligue 1 game.

sections.title: 🇫🇷 Les Bleus
items: **Zidane** names his squad Fri 11/6 at 18:00 Paris / 12:00 PM ET.
**Italy vs. France** Thu 11/12 at San Siro, then **France vs. Türkiye** Sun 11/15 in Bordeaux. Both 20:45 local / 2:45 PM ET. UEFA lists Fubo (pay-per-view) and ViX as its US partners.

sections.title: ⚽ Elsewhere
items: **Como** won **9–1 at Lens** with a **Douvikas** hat-trick, tying the record for the biggest winning margin in the Champions League.
**Fenerbahçe 3–2 Liverpool**, with **Muriqi** heading the winner. Liverpool drop to 8th.

sections.title: 📅 Upcoming
items: **Sat 11/7 · Valencia vs. Real Madrid**, Mestalla: 21:00 local / **3:00 PM ET**. ESPN+ / ESPN Deportes, no free option announced.
**Sat 11/7 · PSG vs. Troyes**, Parc des Princes: 21:05 local / **3:05 PM ET** on beIN Sports. Overlaps with Madrid, so plan on two screens.
